name: Glazed Cottage Roll
description: A sweet and savory glazed cottage roll baked with a mustard and brown sugar crust.

recipeInstructions.text: Remove outer wrapper from cottage roll. Place in large saucepan and cover with water. Add bay leaf, cloves, garlic and onion.
Bring to a boil, cover pan and reduce heat to simmer. Cook for 1½ to 2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 170°F (75°C).
Lift meat from water and remove netting. Place in shallow pan or casserole dish.
Blend mustard and brown sugar together. Spread over cottage roll.
Bake in 425°F (220°C) oven for 15 minutes, basting occasionally, until glaze is set.

keywords: glazed cottage roll, baked ham, sweet glaze

_similar.name: Sliced Ham
_similar.description: A simple baked ham recipe with a brown sugar, mustard, and allspice topping.
recipeIngredient: 6 slices ham, about ½ inch thick

recipeInstructions.text: Place ham slices on a cookie sheet.
Mix brown sugar, dry mustard, and allspice together. Sprinkle over ham slices.
Bake in 350°F oven for 20 to 30 minutes, turning once and sprinkling additional mixture on the other side.

_similar.keywords: baked ham, glazed ham, sweet ham

_similar.name: Chicken Celebrity
_similar.description: A sweet and savory chicken dish with a ketchup-based sauce, perfect for baking.

recipeInstructions.text: Arrange chicken parts in a small roaster or casserole.
Mix the rest of the ingredients together. Spoon over chicken, covering all pieces.
Bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour or until tender.

_similar.keywords: baked chicken, sweet and savory, ketchup-based sauce

_similar.name: Delicious Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A classic meatloaf with a cheddar cheese and carrot mixture, topped with a sweet ketchup-mustard glaze.

recipeInstructions.text: Beat eggs in a bowl with a fork, then add milk, salt, pepper, and crumbled bread. Beat until the bread disintegrates.
Add chopped onion, shredded carrot, cheddar cheese, and ground beef to the bowl. Mix well.
Pack the mixture into a loaf pan.
Combine brown sugar, ketchup, and prepared mustard in a small bowl. Spread this glaze over the meatloaf.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 1½ hours.

_similar.keywords: meatloaf, cheddar cheese, ketchup glaze, classic American

_similar.name: Oven Barbecued Pork Chops
_similar.description: Pork chops marinated in a barbecue sauce and baked in the oven.

recipeInstructions.text: Trim fat from pork chops and place in a single layer in a 13x9 inch baking dish.
Combine ketchup, onions, garlic, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire sauce, chili powder, mustard, and oregano in a bowl.
Pour the sauce over the chops and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or up to 8 hours.
Cover with foil and bake in a 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Uncover and bake, spooning sauce over chops occasionally, for 15 to 30 minutes or until tender.

_similar.name: Spareribs to Go
_similar.description: A versatile spareribs recipe that can be broiled or heated in a glaze sauce, perfect for make-ahead meals.

recipeInstructions.text: Boil spareribs, cut into serving pieces, in salted water for 1½ hours. Drain and place in a shallow dish.
Pour the glaze mixture (garlic and honey) over the ribs. May be frozen for later use.
To finish, remove ribs from the glaze and broil 6 inches from heat in the oven or barbecue until crisp. Alternatively, baste ribs and heat in the sauce.

_similar.keywords: spareribs, garlic honey glaze, make-ahead ribs
